name: Phase 95 Voice Capture, Transcription, and Reviewed Creation Manual UI Evidence

surfaces.ariaLabel: Voice capture and reviewed draft creation controls
testedInteractions: Renders mic toggle button in input bar ('data-tour="assistant-voice-record"') alongside typed prompt field
Starts recording on user click with visible red pulse indicator and live elapsed timer in MM:SS format
Limits capture duration to 600s with automatic stop at boundary
Provides accessible Stop Recording and Cancel Recording buttons
Discloses external transmission step and 0-day transient retention policy notice before transcribing
Provides Transcribe Audio button ('data-tour="assistant-voice-transcribe"') and Discard button
Handles microphone permission denial gracefully, displaying setup instructions while keeping typed text input fully usable
Displays editable textarea ('data-tour="assistant-transcript-edit"') allowing user to review and correct names, dates, times, and amounts
Displays amber warning banner when silence or low-confidence (<0.70) speech uncertainty is detected
Provides 'Generate Proposal' button ('data-tour="assistant-voice-propose"') to feed reviewed transcript into existing reviewed proposal workflow
Provides 'Use in Question' button to transfer edited text into main assistant prompt input
Enforces zero unreviewed mutations: transcription alone NEVER writes organizer records to the database

accessibilityAttributes.keyboardNavigation: All voice controls, textarea, and action buttons navigable and executable via Tab, Space, and Enter
accessibilityAttributes.contrast: Conforms to WCAG AA on light and dark themes using semantic design tokens

testedInteractions: Renders mic button in mobile action bar with 48dp minimum touch target
Shows active recording banner with pulse indicator, live timer, and Stop button ('assistant-voice-stop-btn')
Shows stopped preview bar with audio duration, Transcribe button ('assistant-voice-transcribe-btn'), and Discard button
Renders editable TextInput ('assistant-transcript-input') with multiline support for post-transcription editing
Displays uncertainty banner when audio is flagged with low confidence or silence
Renders 'Generate Proposal' button ('assistant-voice-propose-btn') to initiate reviewed proposal card flow
Provides 'Use in Chat' button to transfer transcript into chat message input
Keeps text messaging fully accessible when microphone permission is denied or recording is inactive

accessibilityAttributes.touchTargetMin: Meets 48dp minimum for all mobile voice action buttons
accessibilityAttributes.screenReaderLabels: Full accessibilityLabel coverage on record, stop, cancel, transcribe, and proposal buttons
